model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the Sensitivity across a sequence of Block Indices, categorized by two configurations labeled "4-Fbit" and "2-Fbit". The horizontal categorical axis is labeled "Block Index" and orders the discrete indices sequentially from left to right, displaying tick labels for indices 0, 6, 13, 20, and 27. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale, with major tick marks and light grey horizontal dashed grid lines at $10^{-5}$, $10^{-4}$, and $10^{-3}$, along with unlabelled minor ticks, covering a range starting from $10^{-5}$ up to $10^{-3}$. A legend in the upper left corner maps blue bars to "4-Fbit" and green bars to "2-Fbit". Each block index is represented by a single vertical bar, colored to indicate its assigned configuration. Index 0 is marked with a blue bar at an approximate value of $1.5 \times 10^{-4}$. Indices 1 through 12 are represented by green bars with values generally ranging between $10^{-5}$ and $3 \times 10^{-5}$, containing the chart's shortest bars around indices 4 and 8 at exactly $10^{-5}$. Indices 13 and 14 appear as blue bars near $5 \times 10^{-5}$, followed by green bars for indices 15 through 18. From index 19 through 27, all bars are blue, demonstrating a progressively increasing sequence of values that culminates in the tallest bar at index 27, which reaches a sensitivity just below $10^{-3}$. The bars are ordered purely by their sequential numerical index, with no additional graphical emphasis or annotations beyond the two-color categorization.
